scope: Read-only production head-advance integration audit; no production frontier implemented

observations.observation: Admission rejects while aft_quv_starting or any live operation exists; there is no explicit finishing/frontier-persistence phase.

Removes the operation under the context lock, then unlocks and sends CompleteQuvOperation before constructing the accepted authorization. It sends the result over a oneshot and ignores receiver disappearance.

Non-Clone, non-serializable local authorization exposes candidate/slot/payload/nonce; expiry and audit are private to the consensus module. No durable frontier transition consumes or borrows this grant.

implementation_consequences: Adding frontier advancement only in the receiver would lose the grant if the receiver disappears; this cannot implement the model assumption that a completed grant is preserved until Advance.

A future durable advance must reserve the local finishing phase until it has committed or entered authenticated-reopen-required state. Removing the operation from the map alone currently allows Begin to admit another operation.
The own-live-authorization check, expiry check and expected-old-frontier compare must be adjacent to the durable write, before exposing the advanced head or forwarding the effect grant.
Remote candidates and completion audits remain data, never transferable frontier authority.
Each correct member still needs its own parent-preparation operation; adding only the local transition does not make the next slot admissible at the other members.
disposition: R1_001_005_009_OPEN; scheduling and grant-preservation integration required, not a new lower bound
